title: Every switch in Settings
persona: A tinkerer who opens every settings page of a new app, flips every switch and changes units, then puts things back.
goal: Open You, then Settings. Visit every section: Privacy, Notifications, Intelligence, Sounds & haptics, Units, Basemap, Fog look, Map performance. Switch units to the other system and back. Look for anything about Pro, purchases or offline maps.
success: Every section opens and closes cleanly, units switched and returned, and no Pro, paywall or price appears anywhere.
